patthana22.29:2.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.29:4.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana22.29:5.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika narūpīduke sanidassanattika rūpīdukaṃ
patthana22.29:6.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.29:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nalokiyaduke sanissanattika lokiyadukaṃ
patthana22.29:8.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: satta.
patthana22.29:10.1: na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanasappaṭigho lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: satta. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.29:11.1: nasanidassanattika nakenaciviññeyyaduke sanissanattika kenaciviññeyyadukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañcattiṃsa. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na
patthana22.29:12.1: kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañcattiṃsa. nasanidassanattika noāsavaduke sanidassanattika āsavadukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
